premises.text: Affordable accessible quality robot hardware is required to accelerate innovation now that other robot subsystems are commoditized
premises.evidence_span: if more people can afford and access quality hardware, then the pace of innovation can be massively increased

premises.text: ModBot sells reconfigurable servo/joint/link modules that integrate industrial joint components at roughly 1/10th cost
premises.evidence_span: reduce the cost of an industrial equivalent by about one-tenth

premises.text: Companion phone app and cloud virtual builder enable wireless programming, simulation, sharing, and ordering
premises.evidence_span: The VR builder has been designed to promote sharing, and when you're done, you can click the order button

premises.text: Target users range from everyday inventors and gamers to researchers and small businesses building local automation
premises.evidence_span: into the hands of everyday inventors. For that, we need good quality and affordable robot parts

value.text: Democratize robot building the way PCs democratized computing
value.evidence_span: we believe that ModBot can do the same for robots

causal_links.evidence_span: robots out of expensive research labs and into the hands of everyday inventors
